narrative.overview:
The whole product is one physical object seen from four desks: a graphite aluminium frame holding an enamel whiteboard, ruled into one slot per bed, with a flat yellow name-tag magnet stuck into every occupied slot. The nurse PC, the support office, the admin hub and the student tablet all show that board, or a sheet laid over it. Nothing is a metric about the room; the board is a picture of the room, 남학생 on the left and 여학생 on the right, slots in real room order, a bunk bed drawn as one frame holding two stacked slots.

The system is built to be read at a glance from across the room. Type is large and heavy (18px body, 24px on the tablet, elapsed time 40 to 56px in tabular numerals like marker on a board), density is low, and colour is spent only on state: yellow means a magnet is there or something is selected, red means the magnet has flipped to its overdue side, graphite is the frame and the primary action. Everything else is enamel white, paper white and slate ink, divided by 1px rules.

The confirmed rejection is the category default: a sidebar dashboard of KPI tiles over a grid of identical cards. State is carried by form as well as colour, so the board still reads with colour removed: a dashed slot is open, a solid magnet is occupied, a red face with a doubled border, a clock and the words "1시간 초과" is overdue.
keyCharacteristics: One frame, one board: graphite shell, recessed enamel board well, paper panels and sheets on top.
Yellow magnet tags for occupied beds; the red side of the magnet for overdue.
Dashed means open, solid means taken.
Heavy tabular numerals for time and counts; elapsed time is the largest text on a tag.
Flat, 1px-ruled surfaces; only magnets and floating sheets cast shadows.
Magnet motion: snap in, lift off, flip to red.
Every colour is a `:root` token in `css/app.css`.

rules.name: The Magnet Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the magnet: it marks an occupied bed, the current selection, the brand mark and the one action the frame is asking for. It never becomes a panel or board background.

rules.name: The Red Side Rule
rules.body: Red is the back of the magnet: overdue, destructive, error, offline. Overdue always arrives as red face plus clock icon plus words, never colour alone. Its single non-alarm use is the scanner beam on the tablet's scan mark, which imitates the scanner's laser.

rules.name: The Root-Token Rule
rules.body: Every colour lives in the `:root` block at the top of `css/app.css`, with derived tokens declared beside their parents; component rules and scripts reference tokens only. Recolouring the app means editing that block and nothing else.

rules.name: The Marker Numeral Rule
rules.body: Elapsed time is the largest text on a magnet, weight 800 with tabular figures and units at 0.42em so the digits carry the reading. Every counted number (free beds, digits, times in tables) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Kiosk 24 Rule
rules.body: On the student tablet no text, button or chip is smaller than 24px; prompts run 36 to 54px.

rules.name: The Whole-Word Rule
rules.body: Korean breaks between words (`word-break: keep-all`). On a magnet, meta items (class, 학번, registration time, source) stay whole and are separated by a 14px gap, never a dot, so no line starts or ends with a separator.

rules.name: The Whole-Slot Reflow Rule
rules.body: The board reflows by whole zones and whole slots only: drop a column, never shrink type or squeeze a magnet to make it fit.

rules.name: The Room-Order Rule
rules.body: Every board view, staff or tablet, keeps 남학생 on the left and 여학생 on the right, with beds in the room's real order.

rules.name: The Only-Magnets-Lift Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the object is stuck onto the board or floats above it. Panels, slots, tables, inputs and graphite or outline buttons stay flat.

rules.name: The Dashed-Means-Open Rule
rules.body: A dashed 1px border marks something open or optional: an empty bed slot, a free bed in the picker and on the tablet, an optional digit cell, the file drop zone, a cancelled status. Occupied and fixed things are solid. The shape carries the state with colour removed.

rules.name: The Nested Corner Rule
rules.body: An inner shape's radius is always smaller than its container's.

rules.name: The One-Line Rule
rules.body: Every rule, border and divider is 1px (`--line`). Heavier strokes mean state: 2px for the overdue outline and checked rings, 3px for focus, the 6px inset rim for the board's edge.

rules.name: The Spaced Destructive Rule
rules.body: On a magnet the safe action (연장, filled) sits at the left; a spacer pushes 퇴실 (outline-only) and the ⋯ menu to the right edge. Destructive steps are confirmed in a sheet whose confirm button is the filled danger button.

dos: Do take every colour from the `:root` tokens in `css/app.css`, adding any new derived token beside its parent.
Do show every bed state by form, colour and words together: dashed slot for free, solid yellow magnet for occupied, red face with the 2px offset outline, clock and "1시간 초과" for overdue.
Do make elapsed time the largest text on a magnet (clamp(40px, 3.4vw, 56px), 800, tabular figures).
Do keep reading text at 18px on staff screens and every text at 24px or more on the student tablet.
Do keep 남학생 left and 여학생 right in room order on every board, with the bunk drawn as one frame holding two slots.
Do nest corner radii, keep rules at 1px, and reserve heavier strokes for state.
Do use the one 24px, 2px-stroke SVG icon set.
Do play the magnet moves (snap in, lift off, flip) on every open screen, and switch them and the scanner beam off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't rebuild the board as a sidebar dashboard of KPI tiles and identical cards.
Don't use red for anything but overdue, destructive, error and offline states (the tablet scanner beam is the one exception).
Don't use yellow as a panel or board background or as decoration.
Don't put shadows on panels, slots, tables, inputs, or graphite and outline buttons.
Don't signal any state with colour alone.
Don't place 퇴실 or any destructive action beside 연장 or give it a fill on the magnet.
Don't shrink type to fit the board; drop a column instead.
Don't write a literal colour in a component rule or in script markup.
